caption:
Stories don't reach new people. Mosseri has confirmed it directly.

Everyone treats this as bad news and it's the most useful thing to understand about Instagram, because it tells you exactly what each surface is for.

Reels and Explore are built on recommendations — they show your stuff to people who don't follow you. That's acquisition.

Feed and Stories run mostly on connected reach — the people who already chose you. That's relationship and conversion.

Stories rank on how likely you are to tap in, like it, or reply to it. All three are intimacy signals, not discovery signals.

So stop measuring Stories on views and asking why they're low. Large accounts see Stories reach 1–2% of followers against 8–12% for feed posts. Stories aren't losing. They're doing a different job: turning the people who already found you into people who talk to you.

Reach is for Reels. Replies are for Stories. Revenue comes from the replies.
